name: Dark Romance: Geumjidoen Gyeonggyeui Gisuksa
source:
As an ordinary fantasy novel enthusiast, you never expected this – “A sorcerer’s descendant?”

Stepping into the enchanting Canseliet College as an exchange student, you soon find yourself swept into a world filled with magic, mystery, and romance. You discover you’re a descendant of a sorcerer, and this school is not only home to students with magical abilities but also alluring non-human beings. Upon entering the “special dormitory,” you begin to uncover secrets that will change your life forever. Will you unlock the mysteries of this school or be drawn into a world of forbidden romance that promises danger and passion?

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.storytaco.c15client]Google Play[/url]]
